entities.name: Circle of Loyalty
entities.description: A legendary ring of eternally burning silver fire at the heart of Castle Ardenvale that detects selfish people and knights the worthy.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: The castle holding the Circle of Loyalty.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: The court whose knights and mages are empowered by the Circle.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion after which the status of the Circle is unknown.

events.summary: After the fall of the Courts in the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Circle's status is unknown.
events.quote: Its status after the fall of the Courts during the New Phyrexian Invasion is unknown.

relations.note: It sits at the castle's heart.
